errors.body_too_large: agentstore: body exceeds the per-file limit
errors.deletion_has_no_content: revision {id} is a deletion and produced no content; revert it instead
errors.invalid_mode: agentstore: restore mode must be revert or reset
errors.invalid_name: the name only takes lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters
errors.no_earlier_version: revision {id} has no earlier version to revert to
errors.reserved_owner: that name is reserved; pick another
errors.secret_in_body: the text looks like it contains a credential (an API key, a token or a private key); take it out: credentials go in Settings
errors.system_skill_name: that name belongs to a system skill; pick another (names starting with octopus- are reserved)
errors.skill_incomplete: a skill needs a prompt.md and a skill.yaml
errors.read_seed: read the catalog seed of workspace {workspace}
errors.write_seed: record the catalog seed of workspace {workspace}
errors.import_needs_workspace: a catalog import needs a workspace
errors.settings_restore: settings are not restored here: load the version into the agent's form and save it
errors.record_def_revision: keep the previous definition of agent {name}
errors.list_def_revisions: list the earlier definitions of agent {name}
errors.import_pack_names: rewrite the pre-1.0 names in the imported agents
